versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Opportunity Navigator.
- Screens current paid coding and AI evaluation opportunities by location, skills, and availability.
- Provides source-backed, needs-matched shortlists with honest NOW/READY/WATCH/SKIP decisions.
- Preserves privacy—never requests sensitive data or transmits user profiles; no external account or payment required for main experience.
- Offers an optional one-time written analysis service after free results, with full explanation and user-controlled contact.
